title: Introduce tenant residency verifier, audit-delta replay service, and staged RBACv2 denylist
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Customers operating in regulated jurisdictions requested a safer path to enforce region-bound KMS usage and tenant data residency while avoiding sudden service disruptions. This PR introduces three coordinated pieces: 1) a residency verifier daemon that validates per-request KMS region claims against tenant residency profiles and flags mismatches; 2) an audit-delta replay service to reconstruct and replay missing or delayed audit events into the central audit sink (useful after partial failures or emergency DB migrations); 3) a staged RBACv2 denylist mechanism that allows operators to push denylist rules in 'audit-only' mode for a configurable period before flipping to enforcement to reduce risk of accidental lockouts. Summary of changes: residency verifier implemented as a lightweight gRPC service (services/residency/verifier.go, internal/residency/validator.go) with a configurable policy backend (configs/residency/policies.yaml); the verifier integrates with the request router to short-circuit requests that are clearly incompatible with tenant pinning when in enforce mode, and emits structured audit events when in monitor mode. Audit-delta replay: new component (pkg/audit/replay/runner.go, pkg/audit/replay/README.md) that can scan local write-ahead logs and S3-backed event caches to identify gaps and replay them to the audit-forwarder with idempotency tokens. Staged denylist: RBACv2 extension (rbac/policies/staged_denylist.yaml, rbac/engine/staged_denylist.go) that supports timestamps, rollforward windows, and gradual enforcement (audit-only -> warn -> deny). Also added migration tooling (tools/migrations/202502_residency_migration.go) and runbook/ops docs (docs/runbooks/residency-onboarding.md, docs/runbooks/audit-replay.md). Why this is different: rather than a hard enforcement flip, the staged denylist gives customers a predictable ramp to full enforcement; the replay path mitigates previously observed audit loss during DB rollovers; and the residency verifier centralizes KMS-region checks so the logic is consistent across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Rollout plan: deployed behind feature flag residency.verifier.enabled=false by default; tenant profiles are imported via a one-time job (tools/importers/tenant_residency_importer.go). Operators can enable monitor mode, validate alerts and audit-only denylist hits for 7 days, then escalate to enforce mode. Monitoring and alerts: added Prometheus metrics residency_verifier_mismatch_total, audit_replay_replayed_events_total and SLO-based alerting (alerts/residency.yaml). Security review: integrates with existing KMS authorizer and signs outbound replay events with service key. Compliance: added GDPR/CCPA notes in docs/runbooks/residency-onboarding.md.

Checklist: - [x] Residency verifier core implementation - [x] Audit-delta replay worker and idempotency - [x] RBACv2 staged denylist and migration path - [x] Unit and integration tests for verifier and replay (ci pipeline) - [x] Runbooks and operator docs - [x] E2E smoke in staging - [x] Feature-flag gating for rollout

Files changed (high level): ["services/residency/verifier.go - new gRPC handler and server glue", "internal/residency/validator.go - core residency logic and cache", "configs/residency/policies.yaml - declarative tenant profiles example", "pkg/audit/replay/runner.go - replay orchestration & s3 adapter", "rbac/engine/staged_denylist.go - evaluation and mode transition logic", "rbac/policies/staged_denylist.yaml - schema + sample rules", "tools/migrations/202502_residency_migration.go - migration script", "tools/importers/tenant_residency_importer.go - CSV/S3 importer", "docs/runbooks/residency-onboarding.md - operator runbook", "docs/runbooks/audit-replay.md - troubleshooting replay failures", "charts/residency/values.yaml - feature flag and replicas", "tests/integration/residency_replay_test.go - e2e scenarios"]

Reviewer conversation highlights: - Marco Liu: "Can the verifier be bypassed for internal system service accounts?" Response: "Yes, added allowlist for system principals and a per-tenant override in validator.go; documented in runbook." - Priya Desai: "Audit replay must be idempotent or we'll double-count billing events." Response: "Replay attaches a replay_id and leverages existing dedupe headers at the audit-forwarder; unit tests validate dedupe behavior." - Evan Brooks: "What happens if replay fails during a control-plane outage?" Response: "Replay is retryable with backoff and writes progress markers to S3; plus an alert and Ops runbook step to run a one-off repair job." - Security team (thread): "Ensure replay events are signed and the verifier cannot be used to exfiltrate residency data." Response: "All outbound replays are signed and residency lookups are permission-checked; added unit tests for unauthorized lookups."

CI notes: initial run had a flaky integration test for audit-forwarder timeout; rerun passed. Pipeline: unit tests (pass), integration (pass on rerun), lint (pass), static analysis (pass).

Performance: residency checks are cached per-service principal with TTL=30s by default to avoid added tail latency. Bench: additional median p95 impact < 2ms on request path in monitor mode; in enforce mode a small added check occurs but still within SLOs.

Merge: Squash-merged to main on 2025-03-04 (merge commit: e5f6a7b). Post-merge actions: published runbooks, created a Linear epic ENG-4570 for rollout automation, and scheduled a staged rollout for a subset of enterprise tenants next sprint.

release_notes: Introduce residency verifier (monitor/enforce modes), audit-delta replay to recover missing audit events, and staged RBACv2 denylist to enable safe ramp to enforcement. Feature gated behind residency.verifier feature flag. Operators should follow runbook to import tenant profiles and run monitor mode before enforcement.
post_merge_actions: Create Linear epic ENG-4570 for rollout automation
Schedule staged enable for pilot tenants next sprint
notes_for_ops: Default is monitor mode. Import tenant residency profiles before enabling enforce. Watch residency_verifier_mismatch_total and audit_replay_replayed_events_total. If audit replay reports persistent failures, follow docs/runbooks/audit-replay.md to run manual replay job.
security_notes: All outbound replay events are cryptographically signed. Residency lookups are permissioned and system principals are allowlisted. No plaintext tenant PII is emitted in audit replays; payloads follow existing audit schema with redaction hooks.
